notes.notes:

Hello fellow racers!
First of all we would like to thank you for all your support. In the past few months we saw an exponential growth in terms of playerbase and engagement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/f300256b2b31617bb942fff9a4db8072d567d461.jpg[/img]

Keep it up!

notes.title: One-year anniversary!
notes.notes:
Time flies with [b]Xenon Racer[/b], its already one year since it was released worldwide on all platforms. We could not be happier with the user reviews with so many of them loving this return to classic arcade drift racing.
The feedback from the Xenon communities has been superb and we really appreciate this including any criticism as it has allowed us to improve the game further in so many aspects.
Since launch we have also added loads of new tracks, cars and liveries all for free to give our players new challenges racing in the future that we imagined.

If you haven’t yet tried out [b]Xenon Racer[/b] don’t miss out on some of the fastest racing you can find. 

Today, for our first anniversary, we therefore want to thank you by releasing the new video below celebrating this milestone with all of you!

[previewyoutube=HNM-sfSWou0;full][/previewyoutube]


Race to the future!

notes.title: An update from the Xenon Racer Team!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/4cefab5c0107852e840b675eb4aecb03b0de209a.jpg[/img]

Xenon Racer continues its unstoppable run on Steam and as so many new pilots have pulled on a helmet to join the race we wanted to thank you all personally.

Before wishing you happy holidays, wherever you may be, we want to share with you a concept of an unprecedented futuristic team. The material was designed as part of a university thesis at the IAAD institute in Turin, Italy and we love the final result. Congratulating "Francesco Randazzo", we hope everyone can release their creative ideas and hurtle down any road that separates from their dreams!

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/731b5254334e84273b6faa58892d6edebcae3125.jpg[/img]

"At the end of the IAAD training course, students are given mentors from within the industry to polish the final version of their thesis, in order to ensure that their projects are also valid from a real world point of view.

I had the good fortune in this final part of the training course to have as my mentor Francesco Bruschi, CEO of 3DClouds, who helped me define and polish my designs and helped me understand the designer-client relationship dynamics.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/5a57b1dde17eef721750af944ef8965ee43eb346.jpg[/img]

Working on the "Andromeda" concept was really exciting for me. I considered the project assigned to me as an experiment to test the skills acquired during my studies, and also an area for personal growth.

The contribution and constant support of my thesis supervisor, Professor Matteo Doro, was very important but also fundamental introducing me to the world of "3D art" which is what I hope will become my future working career.

To conclude, I believe that for any designer there is nothing more gratifying than seeing their ideas realized."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/d16231ec0a61e5b0b3c5572493d35c666fe03df3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33705246/9f78d8341e43fdd6ce22d750ee13b3efaaa8ff57.jpg[/img]

Want to share your creation with us? Join us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/8C4VYkP]Discord[/url] and remember to leave us a review on Steam, that could boost us alot on the store page! Have fun!

[list]
[*]Fixes in AI behaviour. AI will crash less into walls and have less unexpected movements
[*]Fixes in AI difficulty, which result in less unfair situations
[*]Balance fixes between Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty. There should be a more logical elevation in difficulty now
[*]Fixed respawn points on all tracks
[*]Fixed tuning performance on GT LM01 P
[*]Fixed performance of middle wing on GM LM01 P
[*]Fixes in Checkpoint mode, both in edge mode and championship
[*]Fixed problems with binding keys
[*]Fixed problems with binding keys with steering wheels
[*]Removed rear view mirror when racing without any opponents
[*]Fixed problems with unlocking achievements and parts in Time Attack and in multiplayer mode
[*][b]Added skin for LPN05[/b]
[/list]
[h1]Technical updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]Graphical fixes for added performance
[*]Fixed Leaderboard crashes
[*]Fixed some sound and music issues

[*]Fixed invisible wall in Dubai tracks
[*]Fixed Camera problems during the tutorial
[*]Improved performance on Tokyo, Cote d'Azur and Lake Louise tracks

notes.title: Xenon Racer Open Beta is now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Arcade racing is back, because the open beta for Xenon Racer just went live! 

This open beta will run from February 27th 9:00am PST until March 6th 9:00am PST and will contain 4 tracks (of the 40 in total) and 2 cars (of the 18 in total). It also includes full customization options with all options unlocked from the start. This way you can adjust the vehicles to make it unique!

We'd love to hear what you think, so if you have any feedback, please let us know via our survey: https://goo.gl/forms/8UIQZvgn0c87xEtn1. We're also giving away one Xenon Racer game key for a platform of choice for EVERY 100 respondents we get, so the more people respond, the more prizes we'll give out!

That's not all, because there's two more ways you can win the giveaway! We have a leaderboards contest and a photo mode contest.

[b]Leaderboards Contest[/b]
End in first place on the online leaderboards of one of the 4 tracks in the game and win a Xenon Racer game key for a platform of choice! 4 keys in total will be handed out in total and winners will be announced in the Steam Community Hub of Xenon Racer as an announcement and on Discord (https://discord.gg/8C4VYkP).

[b]Photo Mode Contest[/b]
Make the most beautiful shot in photo mode! Access photo mode in the pause menu during a race or select photo mode in the garage to set up your picture and use F12 to capture. Share it to Facebook, Twitter or Instagram using #XenonRacer for a chance to win one of the 6 Xenon Racer game keys of choice! Winners will be announced in the Xenon Racer Steam Community Hub and on Discord (https://discord.gg/8C4VYkP).

I'll see you all on the track ;)

-Marten

notes.title: Xenon Racer to cross the finish line in early 2019, stylish new box art revealed
notes.notes:
[b]Rotterdam, The Netherlands - December 4, 2018 -[/b] SOEDESCO has revealed the official new box art for Xenon Racer. The futuristic arcade racer, developed by Italian studio 3DClouds, is scheduled to launch early 2019 for PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®4 Pro, the Xbox One family of devices including Xbox One X, Nintendo Switch™ and Steam®. For all three consoles, the game releases both digitally and physically.

Download the box art: https://my.hidrive.com/share/gegph7d0-s
Watch the trailer: https://youtu.be/YYLfMgnqjwE
Visit the Xenon Racer website: http://www.xenonracer.com

[b]Drifting through city streets[/b] 
In Xenon Racer, the action takes place in seven different locations across the world, in the year 2030. Two of the racing locations have been revealed already, the bustling metropolis Tokyo and the luxurious city of Dubai. Tokyo offers racers six unique tracks and Dubai offers an additional four, all of which can be raced in reversed direction as well. 

Today, another city was unmasked, taking a major leap westward to the East Coast of the USA. Here, racers can drift around in the city of Boston, Massachusetts, also known as the “City of Champions”. In Boston, players can race on three completely different tracks, in both directions.

[b]Take pole position[/b]
In Xenon Racer, players can race against the AI in Fast Race and Elimination Mode, and  unlock new cars, parts and maps in the singleplayer championship. To practice their racing skills and to break personal records, players can hit the tracks by themselves in Time Attack, Checkpoint Attack and Free Mode. There’s also a local split screen mode and an online multiplayer to challenge others to a race.
